notes: Every place the mod touches TF2, listed so Melty's inspect_package can audit the surface area. Model/animation files are deliberately NOT touched — TF2 bodies stay, only audio and strings change.

touch_points.method: VPK file override — TF2 reads tf/custom/* ahead of tf/tf2_sound_vo_english.vpk
touch_points.reversible: Delete the VPK folder — TF2 falls back to stock audio instantly.

touch_points.method: Localization key overrides for TF_Class_Name_Scout → 'Peashooter', etc. Team-specific keys where TF2 exposes them; shared keys resolved via team-detector plugin.
Override class label column to read from kit name instead of class name. Minor cosmetic edit.
Rewrite class-pick strip buttons to show PvZ names + blurbs from characters.json.
Append entries for new sound events (peashooter_battlecry01 etc.) that point at wav paths produced by the extractor. Does NOT edit stock entries — new names only.
Set tf_bot_quota, difficulty, autoteambalance, map, bot adds. See maps.json.
touch_points.reversible: Delete file (TF2 regenerates autoexec from defaults).

touch_points.method: PyInstaller-packed binary (Python 3.12). On first launch: (a) locate GW2 via EA Desktop IS manifests → Origin registry → Steam fallback; (b) extract required Frostbite audio into tf/custom/pvz_gw2_kit/sound/cache/; (c) write cache/manifest.json listing what was recovered; (d) exit cleanly. Not called again unless user runs 'pvz_gw2_refresh'.
touch_points.reversible: Delete bin/ folder and sound/cache/ folder.
risks: Melty one_click_check may flag the .exe. Mitigation: PyInstaller + code-sign if a cert is available; otherwise document in melty.recipe.json#risks.
Frostbite extraction legally sensitive. See risks sheet.

touch_points.method: Lightweight VScript (TF2 supports Squirrel VScript natively — no SourceMod / no script extender) that listens for player_spawn and swaps the active sound alias for scout based on team. Needed because BLU Scout = Peashooter but RED Scout = Imp share one game_sounds entry otherwise.
touch_points.concern: VScript is only loaded for maps that enable it. koth_harvest_final does. Verify in Phase 2 by printing a chat line from the script on map load.

touch_points.method: On first player_spawn after map load, print one HUD line: 'PvZ GW2 × TF2 v0.1 — Loaded N GW2 sounds from your install' (N read from cache/manifest.json). If manifest absent: 'GW2 install not found — running with stock TF2 audio. Run bin/pvz_gw2_first_run.exe to retry.'
Draws persistent 'PvZ GW2 × TF2 v0.1' in bottom-right during matches. Uses HUDHint API, no custom HUD replacement.

untouched_subsystems: weapon stats / tf_weapon_* scripts — unchanged (gameplay stays TF2)

open_cells.blocker: Pending license-clean route decision (brief open item). If no safe redistributable extractor exists, fallback: ship with GW2 metadata/strings only, document in release notes.
